Samir: T-minus 30 for the stable prod release (service: inference-api). Who's on deploy? Quick confirm: smoke checklist, rollback gates, and owners. Ping if you can't make the window.
Maya: I'm on deploy. Plan to start at :45. Monitoring owner: Liz. @Devon can you confirm DB toggle and traffic toggle are staged?
Devon: DB toggle staged and validated. Traffic toggle config pushed to staging. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/undo-procedure (see section 2). Dry-run command validated. :white_check_mark:
Liz: Monitoring set up: dashboard pinned, alert thresholds configured. Will watch p95 latency, 5xx rate, and token-error rate. Alerts to #eng-oncall.
Samir: Rollback criteria we agreed on earlier:
- 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m
- p95 latency > 350ms for 5m
- Quality regressions: >2/10 failing smoke prompts
If any trigger, execute undo per runbook and notify SRE.
QA-Jordan: Smoke suite running now. Quick paste: ```FAIL test-gen-001: timeout at 12s
PASS test-embed-004```
Maya: Noted. test-gen-001 is flaky historically — re-running with lower concurrency. Devon, can you confirm the traffic cut/undo commands?
Devon: Commands: `redwoodctl routes set inference-api-prod --primary canary-v2 --confirm` to cut. Undo: `redwoodctl routes set inference-api-prod --primary primary-v1 --confirm`. I have the rollback playbook pinned in the runbook.
ops-bot: [deploy scheduled] user=Maya start=2853012385 window=10m
Samir: Final pre-deploy checklist:
1) Owners: Maya (deploy), Liz (monitor), Devon (network), QA-Jordan (smoke)
2) Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/undo-procedure
3) Go/no-go cutoff: 2853012450 (15m from now)
Reply with :thumbsup: to acknowledge, or :hand: to flag issues.
Liz: :thumbsup:
Devon: :thumbsup:
Maya: :thumbsup:
QA-Jordan: :thumbsup: re-running flaky test now.
Samir: Launching at :45 unless anyone raises a blocker. Will post status here. Keep phones ready.
Maya: Starting deploy now. ETA ~3m.
Maya: Deploy complete. Canary at 10%.
Liz: Monitoring: p95=140ms, 5xx=0.02% — healthy. Smoke: 9/10 pass (test-gen-001 still failing).
Samir: Single flaky smoke + stable metrics => continue canary. Ramp to 50% after 5m unless we see regressions.
ops-bot: [ramp] user=Maya target=50% time=2853012645
Devon: Traffic split applied and verified.
Liz: After ramp: p95=160ms, 5xx=0.03%, token errors stable. No signs to rollback.
Maya: Starting full rollout.
Maya: Full rollout complete. No incidents. Closing window. Thanks team :tada:
Samir: Great work everyone. No postmortem needed. QA-Jordan, please open a ticket for test-gen-001 flakiness.
QA-Jordan: Filing JIRA-9282 with logs and reprod steps now.
Samir: I'll update the runbook with owners and mark this window as successful. Good job all.
